title: Carpet Installation, LED light installation, and Painting
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSUP > NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT > NAVSUP FLC NORFOLK > NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR NORFOLK
description:
Solicitation number N0018925QL038  

  (Carpet Installation, LED light replacment, and Painting)  

 The NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center (FLC) Norfolk, Contracting Department, Norfolk, VA 23511-3392 intends to award a firm fixed-price contract for carpet installation. This is solicitation is for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with the format in subpart  12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes only solicitation; proposals are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. The requirement covers the procurement and labor of carpet installation. The procurement action is for NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center (FLC) Norfolk in support of W-143, this information is outlined within the Request For Quote. In accordance with  FAR  19.5 Small Business Total Set Aside, this requirement will be awarded to a Small Business. 

 The requirement was solicited on 23 November 2026- 7 December 2026. The supplies and services needed include carpet installation, led light installation, and cove painting. This quote is to include labor/supplies. This information is located inside of the Statement of Work and outlined in each CLIN. 

 Lack of registration in the SAM database will make a vendor ineligible for award. 

 Any potential contractor capable of demonstrating that it is qualified to perform the work to the required standards and that wishes to make a competitive quote for the contract should submit a capability statement in beta.SAM.gov.  Through its submission, the vendor acknowledges the requirement that a prospective awardee must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database prior to award, during performance, and through final payment of any contract resulting from this solicitation, except for award to foreign vendors for work to be performed outside the United States.  Lack of registration in the SAM database will make a vendor ineligible for award. 

 The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 238330– Flooring Contractors.  The Size Standard is 19 millions of dollars.  The product service code (FSC) is 7220- Floor Coverings. 

 This action will be needed beginning 13 January 2027- 22 January 2027. 

 Vendors may obtain information on registration and annual confirmation requirements by calling 1-999-227-2423, or via the Internet at http://www.sam.gov.  Please direct all questions regarding this requirement to Brittany Simmons brittany.s.simmons3.civ@us.navy.mil. Questions close on 1 December 2026.
